text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm baaaack, death!!!! Everyone,
did you see the moment I crossed the goal!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Welcooome back, El-chan!
Nice run!
After running a great race, El Condor Pasa is instantly surrounded by a circle of cheering crowds.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone's cheers, support, and roaring chants!!
I definitely received them from the stands!!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I am so moved! And so grateful!
Without all your cheers, I never could have run this far!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see, El isn't aiming for
the Triple Crown races, so no matter how
hard she tries, it won't affect anything.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "So you could say it makes it easier to cheer for them without holding back~"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Aah, how cruel, Sei-chan!
Do you hate El or something~?!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha!
Laughter echoes across the Tokyo sky.

The spring for El Condor Pasa
and her friends is coming soon.
choice_data_list: Well then, El, shall we move on to the next story?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, Trainer-san...
*Gulp*...

This is merely a stepping stone.
The real question is what comes next.

A spring without the Classic Road. What steps should
I have her take? I want her to challenge a GⅠ, but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
O-ho-ho, isn't our next race
already decided?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ah, you are—!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
One of the Three Evil Executives...
"Pearl Nathan"!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So that plan is still on the table, is it? ...Even after the Fan Appreciation Festival is over.
Seeking the Pearl. An admired senior to El Condor Pasa, and an Umamusume who achieved magnificent results during her Classic Year spring.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Speaking of spring GⅠ races off the traditional Classic-year path...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The NHK Mile Cup, obviously.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The NHK Mile Cup...!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the mile race where I once
gracefully sped through to claim victory.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If you can make a name for yourself there, you could say
you've taken a massive step toward becoming a world-class Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: A world-class Umamusume...!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, that's where I want to go! To the NHK Mile Cup—the same race Pearl-senpai ran in!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's go with that spot then.
Yeah, let's go with that then.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno!! I've come up with a massive
goal for the spring, too-!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's where El's big showdown is, deeesu!
I'll show everyone going for the Triple Crown
that I'm just as good as them!

The NHK Mile Cup. That's certainly a solid choice.
If we're looking for a Classic-class G1 outside the Triple Crown or Tiara, this is the only one.

If she runs like she did today, she's sure to succeed.
Let's make sure our preparations are flawless before heading in.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufu, but don't underestimate it.
The NHK Mile Cup turns into a fierce battle every year.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The year I ran was a truly fierce battle.
Thunder roared, tearing the racetrack clean in two, and then—!
(RATTLE-SLAM-CRASH!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
W-Won't it just get canceled at this rate...?
I feel like they're hyping it up too much. Ahaha...
